name: Assisteens Auxiliary (Assistance League of Newport-Mesa)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a thrift shop. Help give school clothes to low-income families. Do service projects with your grade. You can also be a leader.
who_can_apply: Young women and men in grades 7 to 12. You must work at least 30 hours a year. Meetings and events count toward hours.
duration: Monthly meetings in the school year. At least 30 hours a year.
deadline_text: No sign-up dates are posted on the program page. Call for details.
how_to_apply: Call 949-645-6929 to ask how to join. The chapter volunteer page has an Adult Member Application. Ask the chapter whether teens can use it.
notes: Membership costs are not stated on the program page. The thrift shop and office are at 2220 Fairview Road, Costa Mesa. Awards go to those with 50, 75 and 100 or more hours a year. Events include a spring luncheon and a June Senior Medallion Event.
